name: mnemonic_reconstruction_shard
label: Shard of Reversal
poeticVision: The desperate, fleeting joy of seeing a forgotten path coalesce from dust, knowing that each restored memory costs a piece of your own. You feel the grit of time reversing underfoot, the structural groan of a memory-world mending itself, only to begin crumbling again, a bittersweet illusion bought with self-loss.
usage: Attach this script to a Node3D in your scene. As children of this Node3D, add a MeshInstance3D (for visual representation) and a CollisionShape3D (for physical interaction). In the inspector, assign the 'shader_path' to the 'reversal_shader.gdshader' file (provided separately). Assign the 'pristine_albedo_texture', 'pristine_normal_texture', 'decayed_albedo_texture', and 'decayed_normal_texture' to appropriate Texture2D resources. Also, provide 'pristine_collision_shape' and 'decayed_collision_shape' resources (e.g., BoxShape3D, ConcavePolygonShape3D) to define the object's physical form in its restored and decayed states. To activate the reversal, call the 'activate_reversal()' method on this node from Lyra's character script or an interaction handler. The cost of activation (loss of a memory fragment or identity meter portion) should be managed by the calling script before invoking 'activate_reversal()'.

parameters.name: shader_path
parameters.description: Path to the GLSL shader file (reversal_shader.gdshader) used for visual interpolation.

parameters.name: pristine_albedo_texture
parameters.description: Albedo texture for the object in its pristine, restored state.

parameters.name: pristine_normal_texture
parameters.description: Normal map texture for the object in its pristine, restored state.

parameters.name: decayed_albedo_texture
parameters.description: Albedo texture for the object in its decayed, initial state.

parameters.name: decayed_normal_texture
parameters.description: Normal map texture for the object in its decayed, initial state.

parameters.name: reversal_duration
parameters.description: Duration in seconds for the visual and physical transition from decayed to pristine.

parameters.name: restored_state_duration
parameters.description: Duration in seconds the object remains in its pristine state before re-decaying.

parameters.name: re_decay_duration
parameters.description: Duration in seconds for the visual and physical transition from pristine back to decayed.

parameters.name: pristine_collision_shape
parameters.description: The CollisionShape3D resource representing the object's physical form when pristine.

parameters.name: decayed_collision_shape
parameters.description: The CollisionShape3D resource representing the object's physical form when decayed.

verdict: A brilliant shard of hope and despair, allowing Lyra to mend the fractured world at the cost of her own fading self.
impact: This invention fundamentally transforms the environment into a dynamic, interactive puzzle, forcing players to make desperate, strategic choices under pressure. The temporary restoration of crumbling memory-worlds, coupled with the implied cost to Lyra's identity, deepens the emotional stakes of every encounter. It creates moments of fleeting triumph against overwhelming decay, making each path forward a bittersweet gamble and reinforcing the core theme of self-loss.
